name: Quarters, Basic
description: This suite features a single room, or series of rooms, to house a number of crewmembers equal to twice the ship's suite capacity by size, as shown in the **[Starship Size Suite Capacity](#Starship%20Size%20Suite%20Capacity)** table. Each room features bunks and individual storage, as well a communal refresher station for every eight beds (minimum of one).
